cheatsNote: Cheats disable trophies and saving while active. There are 61 cheats, and none of them work before the credits — each unlocks after the story, with its own requirement. Do not turn any cheat on during a trophy run.
saveNote: There is no mission replay and no New Game+. The game has 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave slot. Keep a save at the start and end of every chapter (10 saves), then rotate the remaining 5 for free-roam cleanup.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

stages.blurb: Play the opening chapter. Do the balcony meditation before the chapter ends — it is the only thing in the game that may not come back. Start scanning vehicles and studying animals from day one.
stages.tip: After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — learn Leonida, grab the one missable

stages.blurb: Coffee Break unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia and playing together — most later trophies need it. Chapter 3 unlocks the Key Cloner, Yasmani's jewelry jobs and the Dye Pack Jammer path. Buy your first garages when the Real Estate app appears.
stages.tip: Scan every new vehicle and study every new animal you pass — the checklist needs 200 vehicles and 100 animals, and early scanning saves hours of cleanup.
stages.title: Chapters 2–3 — two protagonists, unlock the systems

stages.blurb: Play the story to the credits. Chapter 4 opens the big bank-vault robberies through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — do it when it appears. Make a manual save before the final mission.
stages.tip: After the credits you return to free-roam and everything needed for the platinum is still available. Nothing story-related is missable except the Chapter 1 meditation.
stages.title: Chapters 4–5 — finish the story

stages.blurb: Work these into every trip instead of grinding them at the end: scan vehicles with the WAiNK app, study animals with binoculars, unfog the map with a plane, and train Strength with your partner at fitness clubs.
stages.tip: Unfog the map early — unfogged areas show activity icons, race locations and robbery targets, which makes every later stage faster.
stages.title: Scan, study & explore — the habits that pay off

stages.blurb: The checklist needs every robbery type finished: all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, all 7 Payday Loan jobs, all 8 bank vaults, 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs, 50 of 91 stick-ups, and the four fencing money targets. This stage also pays for the garages and gear.
stages.tip: Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each — the best money in the endgame. Pay Yasmani $10,000 per security-van tip to find them.
stages.title: The 100% checklist — robberies

stages.blurb: The long grind: 300 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials, 30 race wins, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 flamingos, 15 Target Decks, and the partial collectible counts. A Long Road pops when the checklist hits 100%.
stages.tip: Only part of most collectibles is needed (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons) — stop at the checklist number, not at 100% of everything.
stages.title: The 100% checklist — collectibles & activities

stages.blurb: Finish the five character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), hunt Bret's Target Decks, and complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. None of these are part of the 100% checklist, so they are a separate cleanup step.
stages.tip: Watch the character: Andy is Lucia-only, Billy's and Tyrone's lines start from story progress, Randy needs the Key Cloner, Bret is Jason-only.
stages.title: Side strands & character finales

stages.blurb: Sweep up the miscellaneous trophies — the cocktail on Ocean Beach, the UFO easter egg, the two unconfirmed trophies' best leads, the 4-star escape, Combat Focus, the plane and the tank — then check the Planner for anything left. The platinum pops with the last one.
stages.tip: Check the trophy list's own counters before farming anything — Actions Speak Louder counts to 500 and several trophies show their progress there.
stages.title: Cleanup & platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum — 8 stages, about 200 hours
